items.source: If no RouterFunction is provided at construction time, this mapping will detect all router functions in the application context, and consult them in order.
items.translation: 如果没有在构造时提供 RouterFunction，此映射将检测应用程序上下文中的所有路由函数，并按照顺序进行查询。

items.source: If this constructor is used, this mapping will detect all RouterFunction instances available in the application context.
items.translation: 如果使用了此构造函数，该映射将检测应用程序上下文中所有可用的`RouterFunction` 实例。

items.source: On CORS pre-flight requests this method should return a match not for the pre-flight request but for the expected actual request based on the URL path, the HTTP methods from the "Access-Control-Request-Method" header, and the headers from the "Access-Control-Request-Headers" header thus allowing the CORS configuration to be obtained via AbstractHandlerMapping.getCorsConfiguration(Object, HttpServletRequest),
items.translation: 在 CORS 预检请求中，此方法不应针对预检请求返回匹配结果，而应基于 URL 路径、来自"Access-Control-Request-Method"头的 HTTP 方法以及来自"Access-Control-Request-Headers"头的头信息，针对预期的实际请求返回匹配结果，从而允许通过AbstractHandlerMapping.getCorsConfiguration(Object, HttpServletRequest)获取 CORS 配置。

items.source: Note: This method may also return a pre-built HandlerExecutionChain, combining a handler object with dynamically determined interceptors. Statically specified interceptors will get merged into such an existing chain.
items.translation: 注意：此方法也可能返回一个预构建的 HandlerExecutionChain，它将处理器对象与动态确定的拦截器组合在一起。静态指定的拦截器将合并到此类现有链中。

items.source: If this property is used, no application context detection will occur.
items.translation: 如果使用了此属性，则不会进行应用程序上下文检测。

items.source:
Default is "false": Only handler functions in the current ApplicationContext
will be detected, i.e. only in the context that this HandlerMapping itself
is defined in (typically the current DispatcherServlet's context).
items.translation: 默认为"false"：仅检测当前 ApplicationContext 中的处理器函数，即仅在定义此 HandlerMapping 的上下文中（通常是当前 DispatcherServlet 的上下文）进行检测。

items.source:
Switch this flag on to detect handler beans in ancestor contexts
(typically the Spring root WebApplicationContext) as well.
items.translation: 打开此标志以在祖先上下文（通常是 Spring 根 WebApplicationContext）中检测处理器 Bean。

items.source: Determine whether the request matches the given pattern. Use this method when MatchableHandlerMapping.getPatternParser() returns null which means that the HandlerMapping is using String pattern matching.
items.translation: 确定请求是否与给定模式匹配。当MatchableHandlerMapping.getPatternParser()返回null时，使用此方法，这意味着HandlerMapping使用的是字符串模式匹配。

configuration and final initialization when all bean properties have been set.
items.translation: 此方法允许 Bean 实例在其所有属性设置完成后，执行其整体配置验证和最终初始化。
